title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 4. Recalls that mental health is complex and multifactorial and may be influenced by occupational, personal, social and health-related factors; stresses that establishing a causal link between working conditions and damage to health should be based on an objective and individual assessment of each case; considers that the recognition of occupational origin and the applicable burden of proof should remain governed by national law and practice;
